verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an AI assistant and coding CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, usage-tracking or analytics opt-out for the Kimi assistant, Kimi Code CLI/Desktop, or the API platform. The project-level usage tracking on the API platform is billing monitoring, not a privacy opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
